description: Trafic plaisancier dans le lagon du Grand Nouméa en 2013 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ifremer.fr. These results are derived from the statistical extrapolation of data collected during counts carried out by aerial overflights by helicopter in 2013, in number of vessels in navigation by sector of the Spatial Reference System cumulated with the year. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Boating in the Grand Nouméa lagoon in 2013" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include trafic, référentiel spatial, Nouméa, plaisance, fréquentation, usages. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
